risks & watch-items: Execution delays in commissioning; customer approval lags for new facilities; geopolitical volatility in export markets; battery material pricing competition

non-obvious takeaways: Liposomal iron and vitamin C show 80% higher absorption vs conventional; green chemistry reduces waste and capex vs Chinese rivals; NSS acquisition is not just revenue add but margin enhancer via vertical integration

themes.title: Pharma CDMO / CRDMO & API import-substitution
themes.need: Global biopharma's China+1 sourcing plus a peptide/biologics modality boom drive India's CDMO/CRDMO build-out and API import-substitution. ANTHEM/COHANCE/NEULANDLAB/SYNGENE-tier on CRDMO (peptides/ADCs/oligos); DIVISLAB/LAURUSLABS on peptide CDMO; AKUMS/INNOVACAP/RUBICON on formulation CDMO; AARTIPHARM/SUPRIYA/AARTIDRUGS/SOLARA on APIs; SIGACHI/NATCAPSUQ/VIDHIING on excipients.
themes.driver: Customer regulatory filings unlocking dedicated capacity; new CRDMO molecule wins; API price/volume recovery.

hero.oneLiner: Sudeep Pharma is a Vadodara-based mineral-science company that engineers high-purity mineral ingredients for regulated pharmaceutical, food and nutrition markets, and is extending the same chemistry into battery-grade materials for lithium-iron-phosphate batteries.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Sudeep Pharma is a Vadodara-based mineral-science company that engineers high-purity mineral ingredients for regulated pharmaceutical, food and nutrition markets, and is extending the same chemistry into battery-grade materials for lithium-iron-phosphate batteries.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Sudeep Pharma manufactures refined mineral-based single ingredients (calcium, zinc, iron, potassium, magnesium, sodium, copper salts; calcium carbonate as an API) and calcium carbonate excipients for pharmaceutical, food and nutrition customers, and through subsidiary SNPL produces technology-driven specialty ingredients (micronutrient premixes, encapsulated, liposomal, spray-dried and granulated formats). It serves over 1,100 customers across ~100 countries with a portfolio of over 100 products.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Sudeep Nutrition Private Limited (SNPL) — Indian Material Subsidiary: Specialty ingredients vertical
- Sudeep Pharma B.V. (SPBV) — Wholly owned subsidiary (Netherlands): Acquired 85% of NSS
- Sudeep Pharma USA Inc. (SPUI) — Subsidiary
- Sudeep Advanced Materials Private Limited (SAMPL) — Wholly owned subsidiary: Setting up pCAM / battery-grade iron phosphate (EcoCath) facility
- Nutrition Supplies and Services (Ireland) Limited (NSS) — Material Subsidiary (85% via SPBV, w.e.f. May 22, 2025): Vitamin/mineral blends for infant and critical-care nutrition
- Riva Resources Private Limited (RRPL) — Corporate Promoter: Holds 40.93% pre-Offer; pledged shares for debentures
- RAHG Entities (Rettenmaier group - 9 entities) — Group Companies (deemed by SEBI): Did not consent to disclosure; info based only on public domain
- Star Pharmchem — Firm where Sujit and Shanil Bhayani are designated partners: Ordinary-course transactions

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Pharmaceutical, food and nutrition:** Mineral salts (calcium, zinc, iron, potassium, magnesium, sodium, simethicone, copper), Calcium carbonate (API and excipient), Iron phosphate, Excipients (Presscal, Pressmag, Lubriprez, A-comprez)
- **Specialty ingredients:** Micronutrient premixes (sports, clinical, infant, beverage, staple-food fortification), Liposomal ingredients (Lipoboost), Encapsulated ingredients (Novelcap - encapsulated sorbic acid, malic/fumaric/citric acids, minerals, caffeine, choline, DHA), Spray-dried ingredients (CASPRA), Granulated ingredients (WEDRGRAN), Triturates (Tritunova), Cuvamix

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- USFDA approval for manufacture of mineral-based food ingredients (first and only company in India, one of the few worldwide)
- Certificate of Suitability (CEP) from the Council of Europe covering calcium carbonate as an active pharmaceutical ingredient (only company in India, one of nine globally)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Four manufacturing facilities with 12 production lines and six proprietary process technologies; in-house quality-control laboratory for microbial/chemical analysis, stability and impurity testing. Network of 15 warehouses across the US, Europe, Latin America, Africa and Asia (one owned) for storage and delivery; regional sales offices in the US, Europe, UK and Latin America; stocking agreements with third parties; transitioning from distributor-led to direct market access. SAMPL job-work arrangement keeps synthesising/drying/calcination in-house.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Volume of products manufactured and sold is the key revenue driver (pharma/food/nutrition volume 18,922 MT FY25; specialty 8,079 MT FY25); better volumes improve fixed/variable cost absorption
- Customer relationships and demand from top-10 customers determine revenue levels
- Export mix (58.68% of revenue in Q1FY26; 59.27% FY25) exposes results to FX and regional developments
- NSS acquisition makes Q1FY26 results not comparable with prior periods

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Expand into high-growth businesses via SAMPL - battery-grade iron phosphate (pCAM) for EV/energy-storage under EcoCath brand
- Leverage USFDA-approved capabilities for expansion in regulated US/EU markets; transition from distributor-led to direct market access with US/EU warehousing
- Grow Lipoboost liposomal and Novelcap encapsulated product ranges in regulated and emerging markets
- Capitalize on government-led food-fortification programs (rice fortification under TPDS, ICDS, PM POSHAN; African and SE Asian fortification)
- Develop customized solutions and enter international strategic partnerships
- Integrate NSS and pursue further disciplined inorganic growth
- Enhance manufacturing capabilities - new Nandesari excipient facility (51,200 MT)

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Commissioning a new manufacturing facility at Nandesari, Gujarat, spread across 17,529 sq m with proposed annual capacity of 51,200 MT to produce excipients, expected to become operational by Q4 (text also states Q2) of Fiscal 2026, with automation initiatives. Separately, fresh-issue proceeds fund procurement of machinery to expand Nandesari Facility I capacity for different grades of iron phosphate. SAMPL is setting up a pCAM / battery-grade iron phosphate facility, with Sudeep engaged for synthesising, drying and calcination via a job-work agreement dated April 23, 2025.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Market leadership in mineral-based pharma/food/nutrition and specialty ingredients (per F&S Report) with over 100 products in a high-barrier, regulation-heavy industry
- One of the largest producers of food-grade iron phosphate by capacity and one of the largest Indian exporters of mineral ingredients
- Only company in India and one of nine globally with CEP + written confirmation certification for calcium carbonate as an API in the EU; first and only Indian firm with USFDA approval for mineral-based ingredients
- Distinguished global customer base: over 1,100 customers, 40+ blue-chip MNCs, 14 Fortune 500 customers, 7.08-year average tenure with top 5; 78.25% repeat business (FY25)
- Four regulatory-compliant manufacturing facilities with 35 accreditations; six proprietary process technologies
- Strong R&D (two facilities, 41 personnel, 420+ projects, 127 products commercialised); experienced promoter/management team

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Customer concentration — Largest customer 8.15% and top-10 40.78% of revenue in FY25; loss of key customers could hurt results
- Segment concentration — Pharmaceutical, food and nutrition segment is 65.84% of FY25 revenue
- Export dependence — Exports were 58.68%-68.45% of revenue over the periods; exposed to regional/regulatory and FX risk
- Regulatory inspection risk — Manufacturing facilities subject to periodic USFDA/EU inspections and audits
- Geographic concentration — Three of four plants and one of two R&D facilities are concentrated in Vadodara, Gujarat
- Working-capital intensity / negative operating cash flow — Negative cash flow from operating activities in Q1FY26; business requires working capital
- Execution of new/diversification projects — New iron-phosphate/pCAM and excipient expansions unproven; orders for 100% of machinery not yet placed
- Promoter pledge — Promoters pledged shares to Catalyst Trusteeship for RRPL debentures; invocation could dilute promoter stake and trigger open offer

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Commission a new manufacturing facility at Nandesari, Gujarat to produce excipients, adding annual capacity of 51,200 MT.**
- **Deploy fresh-issue proceeds to procure machinery expanding Nandesari Facility I capacity for different grades of iron phosphate.**
- **Through SAMPL, set up a facility to produce precursor cathode active materials (pCAM), beginning with battery-grade iron phosphate (EcoCath) for LFP batteries.**
- **Transition from a distributor-led model to direct market access in the US and Europe, supported by warehousing and local sales/technical teams.**
- **Expand market reach with Lipoboost liposomal ingredients and Novelcap encapsulated products in regulated (EU/North America) and emerging (India/SE Asia) markets.**
- **Capitalize on government-led public-health fortification programs (rice fortification under TPDS, ICDS, PM POSHAN in India; African and SE Asian fortification).**
- **Integrate the recently acquired NSS (Ireland) to strengthen European presence and continue evaluating inorganic opportunities.**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Deepen position in regulated nutrition via the NSS Ireland acquisition, giving a European manufacturing base, advanced premix capability and proximity to customers.
- Move up the value curve in mineral science via the Nandesari greenfield and the Specialty Ingredients vertical (e.g., AbsorBis Bisglycinates, Lipoboost liposomal ingredients), shifting from supplying ingredients to solving customer formulation problems.
- Extend mineral chemistry into electrification through Sudeep Advanced Materials, applying a decade of iron-phosphate experience to battery-grade material via a proprietary, …
